summary: Add inactive restart authority and outcome fencing contracts (unit 8a)

replay.detail: Pending jobs can transition to unknown-after-host-loss; recovery never requeues them or reopens terminal/unknown jobs.

schema.detail: No database changes. Pure release-pin and resolution types only.

rules.detail: INACTIVE: no boot hook, launcher caller or activation. Admission remains not wired until 4c-2 and explicit activation. Authority evidence is a trusted adapter contract, not request authority.

compatibility.detail: Same-node recovery requires the unchanged host, member key and admitted claim, an open window and authenticated recovery record. Launch and recovery share B6 receipt identity/outcome validation; exit codes never decide outcomes.

manual.detail: No policy values or defaults; native execution and cargo checks not run.

recovery.detail: Unit 8 contracts fence uncertain launches without release, relaunch or host re-pinning. Pure tests cover unchanged authority, closed/unauthenticated/rotated evidence, pending states and receipt identity.
